{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(targets)
library(mclust)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

RESOLUTIONS <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20)

# Active references — target name pattern: proj_<ref_id>_<subset>
REFERENCES <- list(
  ferchen_26_mm_bm  = "Ferchen 2026 BM (mm)",
  mca_mm_pbmc       = "MCA Peripheral Blood",
  mca_mm_bm         = "MCA Bone Marrow",
  mca_mm_bm_ckit    = "MCA BM c-Kit",
  mca_mm_bm_mesench = "MCA BM Mesenchyme",
  zeng_25_hs_bm     = "Zeng 2025 BM (hs→mm)"
)
REF_IDS <- names(REFERENCES)
```

Label transfer from 6 curated references across Stroma, HSC, and MNC compartments.

- **Ferchen 2026** — mouse bone marrow (Azimuth, mm).
- **MCA** — Mouse Cell Atlas: Peripheral Blood, Bone Marrow, BM c-Kit, BM Mesenchyme (Azimuth, mm).
- **Zeng 2025** — BoneMarrowMap human BM projected cross-species via ortholog mapping (PCA transfer, hs→mm).

Each reference section has:

- **Projected query: labels** — query cells on the reference UMAP, coloured by predicted label (Azimuth refs only).
- **Projected query: density** — kernel density of query cells on the reference UMAP (Azimuth refs only).
- **Mapping score** — query UMAP coloured by mapping confidence.
- **Summary** — mapping-score violins, resolution × label heatmaps, and ARI curves.

```{r data-load}
tar_load(anno_meta_hsc);             tar_load(annotation_recluster_hsc)
tar_load(anno_meta_mnc);             tar_load(annotation_recluster_mnc)
tar_load(anno_meta_stroma);          tar_load(annotation_recluster_stroma)

hsc_df    <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_hsc,    annotation_recluster_hsc)
mnc_df    <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_mnc,    annotation_recluster_mnc)
stroma_df <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_stroma, annotation_recluster_stroma)
rm(anno_meta_hsc, annotation_recluster_hsc,
   anno_meta_mnc, annotation_recluster_mnc,
   anno_meta_stroma, annotation_recluster_stroma)
gc()
```

```{r proj-load-helper, include=FALSE}
# Load and merge projection data for one reference.
# Stops with a clear error if any compartment target is missing — build the pipeline first.
load_proj <- function(ref_id) {
  list(
    hsc    = anno_merge_proj(hsc_df,    tar_read_raw(paste0("proj_", ref_id, "_hsc"))),
    mnc    = anno_merge_proj(mnc_df,    tar_read_raw(paste0("proj_", ref_id, "_mnc"))),
    stroma = anno_merge_proj(stroma_df, tar_read_raw(paste0("proj_", ref_id, "_stroma")))
  )
}

# Load reference UMAP data.frame from a named pipeline target.
# Stops with a clear error if the target has not been built yet.
load_ref_umap <- function(target_name) {
  tar_read_raw(target_name)
}

# Build shared colour palette for reference + predicted cell types.
make_pal <- function(ref_df, dfs, label = "cell_type") {
  predicted_label <- paste0("predicted.",label)
  pred <- unlist(lapply(dfs, function(d) {
    if (predicted_label %in% colnames(d)) d[[predicted_label]] else NULL
  }))
  anno_make_type_pal(ref_df, pred, label)
}
```

## Ferchen 2026 BM (mm)

```{r ferchen-setup, include=FALSE}
.name     <- "Ferchen 2026 BM (mm)"
.label    <- "Level2"
.ref_key  <- "UMAP"      # ref_df columns: UMAP1, UMAP2
.proj_key <- "UMAP_"  # query columns:  refumap_1, refumap_2
.ref_df   <- load_ref_umap("ferchen_26_mm_bm_umap")
.dfs      <- load_proj("ferchen_26_mm_bm")
.pal      <- make_pal(.ref_df, .dfs, .label)
```

### Projected query: labels

::: panel-tabset
#### HSC

```{r ferchen-labels-hsc, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ref_plot_labels(.dfs, .ref_df, .pal, .name, "hsc", .label, .proj_key, .ref_key)
```

#### MNC

```{r ferchen-labels-mnc, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ref_plot_labels(.dfs, .ref_df, .pal, .name, "mnc", .label, .proj_key, .ref_key)
```

#### Stroma

```{r ferchen-labels-stroma, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ref_plot_labels(.dfs, .ref_df, .pal, .name, "stroma", .label, .proj_key, .ref_key)
```
:::

### Projected query: density

::: panel-tabset
#### HSC

```{r ferchen-density-hsc, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ref_plot_density2(.dfs, .ref_df, .pal, .name, "hsc", .label, .proj_key, .ref_key)
```

#### MNC

```{r ferchen-density-mnc, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
ref_plot_density2(.dfs, .ref_df, .pal, .name, "mnc", .label, .proj_key, .ref_key)
```

#### Stroma


### Mapping score

::: panel-tabset


#### MNC


## Zeng 2025 BM (hs→mm)

Cross-species projection: query cells renamed to human orthologs → transferred onto Zeng 2025 BoneMarrowMap via PCA anchors. Labels: `predicted.CellType` and `predicted.CellType_Broad`. No reference UMAP projection (different label structure — density/labels panels are not available).

```{r zeng-setup, include=FALSE,message=FALSE}
.name     <- "Zeng 2025 BM (hs→mm)"
.label    <- "CellType_Broad"   # predicted column: predicted.CellType_Broad
.ref_key  <- "UMAP_"             # unused (no ref UMAP), kept for API consistency
.proj_key <- "refUMAP_"
.ref_df   <- load_ref_umap("zeng_25_hs_bm_umap")
.dfs      <- load_proj("zeng_25_hs_bm")
.pal      <- make_pal(.ref_df, .dfs, .label)
```

## SingleR annotation

Automated label transfer using bulk RNA-seq references from `celldex`.
Three references chosen for haematopoiesis / blood development relevance:

- **NovershternHematopoieticData** — 211 human haematopoietic bulk samples,
  38 cell types spanning all major lineages (Novershtern *et al.* 2011).
- **ImmGenData** — mouse Immunological Genome Project; comprehensive immune
  atlas (mouse, most directly comparable to BM data).
- **MouseRNAseqData** — mouse bulk RNA-seq compendium; broad cell types useful
  as a sanity check across all three compartments.

```{r singler-libs, message=FALSE}
library(SingleR)
library(celldex)
library(BiocParallel)
```

```{r singler-refs, message=FALSE}
tar_load(mm_hs_ortho_long)   # columns: Mouse.gene.name, human_ortho

ref_novershtern  <- celldex::NovershternHematopoieticData()
ref_immgen       <- celldex::ImmGenData()
ref_mouse_rnaseq <- celldex::MouseRNAseqData()

# Rename Novershtern (human) rownames → mouse ortholog symbols so they align
# with the query SCT matrix.  Keep only strict 1:1 pairs to avoid duplicate
# rownames (many-to-many entries like HSD3B1/2 are dropped).
ortho_1to1 <- mm_hs_ortho_long |>
  dplyr::filter(human_ortho %in% rownames(ref_novershtern)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(human_ortho)      |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 1) |> dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::group_by(Mouse.gene.name)  |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 1) |> dplyr::ungroup()

ref_novershtern_mm <- ref_novershtern[ortho_1to1$human_ortho, ]
rownames(ref_novershtern_mm) <- ortho_1to1$Mouse.gene.name

message(sprintf("Novershtern: %d human genes → %d 1:1 mouse orthologs retained",
                nrow(ref_novershtern), nrow(ref_novershtern_mm)))

SINGLER_REFS <- list(
  "Novershtern Haematopoietic" = list(ref = ref_novershtern_mm, label_col = "label.main"),
  "ImmGen (mouse)"             = list(ref = ref_immgen,          label_col = "label.main"),
  "Mouse RNAseq (broad)"       = list(ref = ref_mouse_rnaseq,    label_col = "label.main")
)
```

```{r singler-helpers, include=FALSE}
# Run SingleR for one expression matrix against all SINGLER_REFS.
# Returns a named list of SingleR result objects.
run_singler_all <- function(expr_mat) {
  lapply(SINGLER_REFS, function(r) {
    SingleR::SingleR(
      test    = expr_mat,
      ref     = r$ref,
      labels  = r$ref[[r$label_col]],
      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
    )
  })
}

# UMAP coloured by SingleR predicted labels.
plot_singler_umap <- function(umap_df, pred, title, n_max = 30000L) {
  pred_df <- data.frame(cell_id = rownames(pred), label = pred$labels,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # hsc_df / mnc_df / stroma_df carry cell_id as a plain column (anno_merge_recluster
  # uses merge(), so rownames are integers — not barcodes).
  if (!"cell_id" %in% colnames(umap_df))
    umap_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(umap_df, "cell_id")
  df <- dplyr::inner_join(umap_df, pred_df, by = "cell_id")

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("plot_singler_umap: no cells matched — check cell ID format.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (nrow(df) > n_max) df <- df[sample(nrow(df), n_max), ]

  lvls  <- sort(unique(df$label))
  n_col <- max(3L, min(length(lvls), 12L))   # brewer.pal requires n >= 3
  pal   <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n_col, "Paired"))(length(lvls)),
    lvls
  )
  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = label)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3), ncol = 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))
}

# Score heatmap with optional cell subsampling (plotScoreHeatmap is slow at > 2k cells).
plot_singler_scores <- function(pred, n_sample = 500L, title = NULL) {
  if (nrow(pred) > n_sample) {
    idx  <- sample(nrow(pred), n_sample)
    pred <- pred[idx, ]
  }
  SingleR::plotScoreHeatmap(pred, show.labels = TRUE,
                            main = title %||% "")
}

# Label bar-chart: proportion of cells per predicted label.
plot_singler_bar <- function(pred, title = NULL) {
  df <- as.data.frame(table(label = pred$labels)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(prop = Freq / sum(Freq)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prop))
  df$label <- factor(df$label, levels = df$label)
  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = label, y = prop)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#4393c3") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1)),
                       hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of cells", title = title) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10)
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
```
